description: DASHBOARD: add the /player-sweep admin page to reporting-ui (Next.js 16, output:'export', client-only). A typed worker API client (lib/api/playerSweep.ts) wraps the two FEAT-001 endpoints and parses a pasted PlayHQ URL/season id. The page previews a season's grades (competition + org + grade list) then drives the resumable sweep client-side with live progress and a Stop button. Register /player-sweep in the permission system (PAGE_KEY_ALIASES -> 'admin-config') so the AppShell route guard allows it, and add a Sidebar nav entry. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (consumes /api/competition/:seasonId/grades and /api/admin/sweep-competition) — do FEAT-001 first.
steps: cd c:\Users\AndyDin\reporting-dashboard\.worktrees\comp-sweep\reporting-ui && npm install (node_modules is absent). THEN, per AGENTS.md, read the relevant Next.js 16 guides under reporting-ui/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ (they only exist after install): the App Router page.tsx conventions, the static exports (output:'export') guide (confirm no server routes/handlers/actions; a plain non-dynamic page needs no generateStaticParams), and the 'use client' directive guide. Heed deprecation notices.

Read the house-style/reference files FIRST: lib/api/players.ts (WORKER_BASE convention + getPlayerCareer error mapping), lib/api/auth.ts (PAGES, PAGE_KEY_ALIASES, pageKeyForPath), components/auth/AppShell.tsx (route guard), app/admin-config/page.tsx (dark theme, inputCls, buttons, Loader2/AlertTriangle), components/layout/Sidebar.tsx (nav sections).

Create lib/api/playerSweep.ts. Declare WORKER_BASE EXACTLY like lib/api/players.ts: const WORKER_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAYHQ_WORKER_URL?.replace(/\/$/, '') || 'https://playhq-scores.premier-data-enterprise.workers.dev'. Export types SeasonGrade { id; name; gender: string|null; age: string|null; day?: string|null }, SeasonGradesResponse { season:{id;name;status?}; competition:{id;name;type?}; organisation:{id;name;type?}; grades: SeasonGrade[] }, and SweepBatchResult { season; competition; organisation; grades: SeasonGrade[]; gradeIndex:number; gradeId:string; gradeName:string; totalGames:number; offset:number; limit:number; processed:number; skipped:number; done:boolean; next: { gradeIndex:number; offset:number } | null }.

In playerSweep.ts add parseSeasonId(input: string): string — trim; if it looks like a URL, attempt to extract the SEASON short id from a season/competition-level PlayHQ URL (simple, forgiving regex); otherwise return the trimmed input. Document that a game-centre URL carries a GAME id (not the season id); fallback returns the trimmed input as the season id.

In playerSweep.ts add getSeasonGrades(seasonId): GET `${WORKER_BASE}/api/competition/${encodeURIComponent(seasonId)}/grades` with { cache:'no-store' }; on !ok throw an Error carrying the worker { error } field (mirror getPlayerCareer). Add sweepCompetitionBatch({ season, gradeIndex, offset, limit, token }): GET `${WORKER_BASE}/api/admin/sweep-competition?season=...&gradeIndex=...&offset=...&limit=...&token=...` (encodeURIComponent each) with { cache:'no-store' }; same error mapping; returns SweepBatchResult. Token is a function arg only (never stored in code/env).

Edit lib/api/auth.ts: add '/player-sweep': 'admin-config' to the PAGE_KEY_ALIASES map (mirroring how '/player' aliases to 'live-scores'). Add a short comment explaining /player-sweep inherits admin-config's permission. Do NOT add a new PAGES entry (would default to denied for existing roles).

Create app/player-sweep/page.tsx as a 'use client' plain (NON-dynamic) page — static-export safe, no generateStaticParams. Match admin-config's dark theme: outer div min-h-full bg-gradient-to-b from-[#0B1220] via-[#0d1526] to-[#0f172a] text-slate-100; inner mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-6; h1 title + descriptive

. Use the inputCls string from admin-config and sky/emerald accent buttons, Loader2/AlertTriangle from lucide-react.

Page Step 1 (Preview): a text input (URL or season id) + Preview button -> parseSeasonId -> getSeasonGrades; render competition name + organisation name + a table/list of grades (name, gender, age, and the short id in mono). Show an inline hint that a game-centre URL has a GAME id, so paste the SEASON id or season-page URL. Show load/errors inline (AlertTriangle amber box like admin-config).

Page Step 2 (Sweep): a token <input type='password' or text> (user pastes BACKFILL_TOKEN; never embedded) + Start and Stop buttons. On Start, run a client loop starting at { gradeIndex:0, offset:0 }: call sweepCompetitionBatch, accumulate processed/skipped, show current gradeName, this-batch processed/skipped, cumulative totals, and 'grade X of N' (N = grades.length), then follow result.next until result.done. Use a useRef cancellation flag toggled by Stop to halt cooperatively. Catch per-batch errors: show the error but continue to the next cursor where safe (e.g. advance past a failing grade) and let the user Stop; stop the loop on repeated/fatal errors. Disable Start while running.

Edit components/layout/Sidebar.tsx: add an item linking to /player-sweep (e.g. in the 'LEAGUE APPS' section near Admin Configuration) using a lucide-react icon (reuse an imported one or import a new one). Its visibility flows through hasAccess(pageKeyForPath('/player-sweep')) -> the alias added in auth.ts.
Typecheck + build: cd reporting-ui && npx tsc --noEmit (clean), then npm run build (succeeds) and confirm out/player-sweep.html exists. Optionally npm run test (vitest) stays green.
acceptance_criteria: lib/api/playerSweep.ts declares WORKER_BASE via NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAYHQ_WORKER_URL (same fallback as players.ts, not hardcoded) and exports getSeasonGrades, sweepCompetitionBatch, parseSeasonId with the typed shapes.
/player-sweep is registered in PAGE_KEY_ALIASES -> 'admin-config' so the AppShell guard allows it for admin-config-permitted roles (no redirect to /dashboard).

app/player-sweep/page.tsx is a 'use client' non-dynamic page that previews grades (competition + org + grade list) and runs the resumable sweep client-side with live progress (current grade, processed/skipped, grade X of N), per-batch error display, and a working Stop button; it matches the admin-config dark theme.
The token is supplied via a UI input and passed per request; it is never embedded in client code or env. The worker base URL is not hardcoded.
cd reporting-ui && npx tsc --noEmit passes AND npm run build succeeds producing out/player-sweep.html.
verification: cd c:\Users\AndyDin\reporting-dashboard\.worktrees\comp-sweep\reporting-ui && npm install && npx tsc --noEmit  (must be clean)
npm run build  (must succeed) and out/player-sweep.html must exist
Optional: npm run test (vitest) remains green
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. (1) reporting-ui/lib/api/playerSweep.ts — new typed worker client. WORKER_BASE declared EXACTLY like lib/api/players.ts (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAYHQ_WORKER_URL?.replace(/\/$/,'') || the workers.dev fallback; NOT hardcoded). Exports types SeasonGrade, SeasonGradesResponse, SweepBatchResult (shapes match FEAT-001's cursor contract exactly), plus parseSeasonId (forgiving URL parse: extracts the last short-id-like path segment of a season/competition PlayHQ URL; documents that a game-centre URL carries a GAME id so the fallback returns the trimmed input verbatim), getSeasonGrades (GET /api/competition/:seasonId/grades, cache:'no-store', error mapping mirrors getPlayerCareer via a shared errorFrom() that surfaces the worker { error } field), and sweepCompetitionBatch({season,gradeIndex,offset,limit,token}) (GET /api/admin/sweep-competition with each param encodeURIComponent'd; token is a function arg only, never stored). (2) reporting-ui/lib/api/auth.ts — added '/player-sweep':'admin-config' to PAGE_KEY_ALIASES (with an explaining comment), mirroring '/player'->'live-scores'; no new PAGES entry (avoids default-denied). The AppShell guard now allows /player-sweep for admin-config-permitted roles. (3) reporting-ui/app/player-sweep/page.tsx — new 'use client' NON-dynamic page (static-export safe; no params/searchParams, no generateStaticParams, no server routes/handlers/actions). Matches admin-config dark theme (min-h-full bg-gradient from-[#0B1220] via-[#0d1526] to-[#0f172a], max-w-6xl container, shared inputCls, sky/emerald/red accent buttons, Loader2/AlertTriangle icons). Step 1 Preview: URL/season-id input -> parseSeasonId -> getSeasonGrades, renders competition + organisation + season names and a grades table (#, name, gender, age, mono short id) with the game-centre-id hint and an amber AlertTriangle error box. Step 2 Sweep: type=password token input + Start/Stop buttons; on Start a client loop runs from {gradeIndex:0,offset:0}, calls sweepCompetitionBatch (limit 10, worker caps at 12), accumulates processed/skipped, shows 'grade X of N' (N=grades.length), current gradeName, this-batch and cumulative totals + batch count; follows result.next until result.done. A useRef cancellation flag toggled by Stop halts cooperatively; per-batch errors are shown and the loop advances past a failing grade (offset 0 of the next grade) where safe, bailing after 3 consecutive errors. Start is disabled while running. (4) reporting-ui/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx — added a 'Player Sweep' item (new ScanLine lucide icon import) in the LEAGUE APPS section next to Admin Configuration; visibility flows through hasAccess(pageKeyForPath('/player-sweep')) -> the admin-config alias.

VERIFICATION: npm install OK (653 pkgs). Per AGENTS.md read the on-disk Next.js 16 docs (node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/...): use-client directive, page.js file conventions, and the static-exports guide — confirmed a plain client page with no params/searchParams needs no generateStaticParams and that output:'export' forbids server routes/handlers/actions/Server Actions (none used). npx tsc --noEmit CLEAN (exit 0). npm run build (Next.js 16.2.10, Turbopack) SUCCEEDS; /player-sweep listed as a static (○) route and out/player-sweep.html is produced (11,517 bytes). Optional vitest: 195/195 tests pass across 15 files (unchanged, still green).

NOTE (build env, not a code change): the worktree had NO reporting-ui/.env, so the first build failed prerendering Supabase-backed pages (e.g. /fixtures: 'supabaseUrl is required'). This is an environment gap unrelated to FEAT-002 — /player-sweep itself uses no Supabase. Copied the gitignored .env and .env.local from the main checkout (c:/Users/AndyDin/reporting-dashboard/reporting-ui) into the worktree so the build could complete; these files are gitignored and were NOT committed. CARRY-OVER from FEAT-001 (still UNVERIFIED LIVE): no PHQ_API_KEY/BACKFILL_TOKEN was available, so an end-to-end sweep slice was not run; the short-grade-id-vs-UUID question for the REST grades endpoint remains open. When a real token is available, open /player-sweep, preview season ce93ea21, and run the sweep to confirm processed>0 (grade ce56b707). If the short id is rejected by fetchGradeGames, a UUID-resolution shim must be added in the worker (FEAT-001), not the UI.
